name: Azure Database for PostgreSQL
sku: Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server, running the community version of PostgreSQL. The V6 SKU family is in preview and is not scored.

source.oltp.note: A fully managed PostgreSQL service that runs the community version, with full application compatibility, a built-in PgBouncer connection pooler, and Burstable, General Purpose and Memory Optimized compute tiers.

bands.note: Automated patching in a managed maintenance window, automatic backups kept 7 days by default and up to 35, and high availability within one zone or across zones with zero data loss.
Built-in performance monitoring and alerting: one-minute metrics with 30 days of history, alerts on metrics and configurable slow query logs.

presentation.tagline: Managed community PostgreSQL with zone-redundant high availability.
